meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能接入 Linear 频道,自动回复你指定团队里每个 issue 的评论线程;每条新评论都会触发它,无需 @提及;每个 issue 线程作为独立对话,首次回复时会问候用户。
howto.when: 当所选 Linear 团队的任何 issue 下有新评论时触发,无需 @提及;webhook 接收到评论事件后自动响应。

say.text: 帮我接入 Linear 的 issue 评论
say.note: 开始执行 Linear 频道配置流程。

say.text: 用 OAuth 应用方式配置 Linear
say.note: 以应用身份发帖,自己的评论不会被过滤。

say.text: 配置 Linear 时用 Personal API Key
say.note: 以你的身份发帖,你自己的评论会被忽略。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can integrate with Linear and automatically reply to every comment on issues in the chosen team. No @-mention needed. Each issue thread becomes its own conversation, and the agent greets people when first answering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new comment is posted on an issue in the selected Linear team. Webhook-driven; all comment events are received automatically, no @-mention required.

say_en.text: Set up Linear issue comments for me
say_en.note: Starts the Linear channel configuration flow.

say_en.text: Configure Linear using an OAuth app
say_en.note: Posts as app, your own comments not filtered.

say_en.text: Configure Linear with a Personal API Key
say_en.note: Posts as you; own comments ignored.
